item.title: Sedatives widely used on dementia patients despite efforts to reduce them
item.description: Powerful sedatives are commonly given to agitated dementia patients in long-term care facilities, even as federal officials try to limit their use.

item.title: HHS report claims gender-affirming care may radicalize
item.description: The report is the agency's latest move to undermine trust in established transgender health care. Critics say it frames transgender people as a threat.
